title: External compute remains an optional provider adapter
statement: Any hosted AI or external compute capability remains opt-in behind a typed provider adapter with consent, residency, retention, timeout, budget, and audit controls.
rationale: The product can add external compute without making it authoritative, mandatory, or capable of bypassing Vistara lifecycle policy.
